notes: A sweep for small mistakes. Add-ons on a quote now sit on one line instead of stacking; the kit shelf lines up on the left; the two clip-count boxes on a delivery sit side by side; a stray code escape in a hint is gone, and the mileage box is wide enough to read. The sign-off title field now shows when your signature is on, and the hint under automatic change-listing finally appears when it is off. With no freelance agreement in Setup, nothing in the app mentions one any more - not the crew rows, the booking emails, the checks or the hints. The storage notes say what is true of the Mac app rather than a browser, and some code that could never run has been taken out.
